targets.statement: Yield requires slowing and giving crossing vehicles the right-of-way, proceeding slowly without stopping if clear; Do Not Enter bars entering one-way streets and roadways, whereas Wrong Way requires turning around immediately; a red circle and slash prohibits the pictured action; and Speed Limit, Exit Speed, and active school or work zone doubled-fine signs regulate speed.
